sourceTitle: George Washington Carver Peanut Recipes: No. 3, Peanut Bisque
sourceText:
George Washington Carver Peanut Recipes: No. 3, Peanut Bisque
By: Barnaby Dorfman
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 8:07pm

Ingredients




3 cups milk
1/2 teaspoon onion, chopped
pinch of salt and pepper
1 tablespoon flour
1/2 cup peanut butter

Preparation

1 To 3 cups of boiling milk, add half a teaspoon chopped onion, a pinch of salt and pepper; rub to a smooth paste a tablespoon of flour with water; add half cup of peanut butter; stir in the flour; boil 3 minutes longer; serve with peanut wafers.

About


From George Washington Carver's famous bulletin: "How to Grow the Peanut and 105 Ways of Preparing it for Human Consumption."
